properties.name: Pre-Flood World
properties.description: The earth was filled with violence and corruption. God determined to destroy all flesh with a flood.
properties.debate: The pre-Flood world may have had a single supercontinent and different geography entirely.

properties.name: Land of the Nephilim
properties.popup: DISPUTED: Giants in the earth - Genesis 6:4
properties.description: The Nephilim were on the earth when the 'sons of God' took the 'daughters of men.' These were mighty men of renown.
properties.debate: Nephilim identity debated: fallen angels' offspring, Sethite/Cainite intermarriage, or tyrannical rulers.

properties.name: Noah's Ark Construction Site
properties.popup: DISPUTED: Where the ark was built - Genesis 6:14-22
properties.description: Noah built the ark of gopher wood, 300x50x30 cubits. Construction took up to 120 years.
properties.debate: The ark was built somewhere in the pre-Flood world. That location was destroyed by the Flood itself.
properties.archaeology: The ark's dimensions (450x75x45 feet) represent ideal ship proportions, confirmed by modern naval architecture.

properties.name: Gopher Wood Forests
properties.description: Noah was commanded to build the ark of 'gopher wood' - a term only used here. Possibly cypress or another resinous wood.
properties.debate: Hebrew 'gopher' is uncertain. Cypress, pine, or cedar have been proposed. Pre-Flood forests were likely vast.
